summary: 04.10b Invoice templates — first test pass. BACKEND (6/7 pass): new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_templates.py — GET /api/settings/invoice now returns template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size (defaults t3, #014747, '', 90); PUT persists template/brand/logo_url/logo_size and rejects 'template=t9' with 422; POST /api/upload accepts a 1x1 PNG built in-memory and returns {path: 'tredi/uploads/<uid>/<uuid>.png', url: '/api/files/…', size}; GET /api/files/{path}?token=<jwt> returns the PNG bytes with Content-Type image/png and Cache-Control private; unauthenticated /api/upload → 403 (Not authenticated) and /api/files/{path} without token → 401. Regression pytest test_tredi_api.py + test_duplicate_invoice.py + test_pass2_api.py = 73/73 still pass. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the seventh test — test_invoice_settings_save_does_not_wipe_template — fails: saving the plain /settings/invoice screen (which sends payload WITHOUT template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size) resets those four fields to Pydantic defaults t3 / #014747 / '' / 90 on the server, because /api/settings/invoice PUT does a full model_dump() overwrite of settings.invoice. This directly contradicts the review requirement 'confirm saving invoice settings does NOT wipe the template/brand colour values'. FRONTEND (390x844, owner@tredi.app / tredi1234): 'Invoice templates' row is present in the More tab with correct testID more-invoice-templates. /settings/invoice-template renders (testID invoice-templates-screen visible) with no red screen. Tapping swatch templates-color-2C6ECB updates the hex field text to '#2C6ECB' and highlights the swatch with a checkmark. templates-size-120 selects Large, templates-custom-size text field accepts a numeric value, templates-show-photos toggle flips on. templates-pick-t5 highlights Template 5 with the brand-tertiary border and re-tints the other five thumbnails to the chosen brand colour. templates-save shows toast 'Saved · Every invoice will use this look'. After full page reload + direct nav back to /settings/invoice-template, the hex '#2C6ECB', custom size 120, show-photos ON and the highlighted template all persisted. Opening /invoices/pdf/<invoice id> (invoice fetched from GET /api/invoices) renders testID pdf-paper — the 'Balance due' row background is computed rgb(44, 110, 203) = #2C6ECB (exactly the saved brand colour), the invoice header shows the business name 'Tredi Ventures', pdf-download and pdf-share buttons are present, and 'Made with tredi' still shows in the footer. Zero React Native red screen. Only a single benign 401 console message (an earlier fetch retry). The /settings/invoice screen renders with testID invoice-settings-screen and now has the new settings-templates row that pushes to /settings/invoice-template. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues: none detected in the two new files. Owner settings restored to t3 / #014747 / 90 at end of run.

critical.issue: The general invoice-settings save (the payload sent by /app/frontend/app/settings/invoice.tsx — prefix/next_number/vat_rate/vat_on/due_days/conditions/show_photos/tredi_mark/print_format/default_bank_account_id/attach_terms/footer, NO template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size) wipes template→t3, brand_color→#014747, logo_url→'', logo_size→90 because the server does {"$set": {"settings.invoice": data.model_dump()}} and Pydantic fills in defaults for the missing fields. Proven by test_invoice_settings_save_does_not_wipe_template: set t5/#7A4BD0/60 via a full PUT, then send the plain invoice-settings PUT, then GET → template=t3, brand_color=#014747, logo_size=90. Fix on server: keep the existing branded fields when the payload doesn't include them (e.g. read the current doc, merge, then $set, OR only $set the keys that were provided). Alternatively on the client: /app/frontend/app/settings/invoice.tsx save() must spread the existing q.data so template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size ride along. Reference: /app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:81-85 + /app/frontend/app/settings/invoice.tsx:30-40.

integration_issues.issue: Because the invoice-settings screen omits the four template fields in its PUT payload, saving it silently resets the branded look. The templates screen itself (invoice-template.tsx) does spread q.data so its own Save is fine, but ANY subsequent save on /settings/invoice will clobber the user's chosen template and brand colour. Same root cause as the backend critical bug above.

action_items: CRITICAL: stop /settings/invoice from wiping template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size. Preferred fix — in /app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:put_invoice_settings, read the existing settings.invoice document and merge, e.g.: current = (biz.get('settings') or {}).get('invoice') or {}; merged = {**current, **data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)}; then $set settings.invoice = merged. Also switch the endpoint to accept data as a Pydantic model with exclude_unset=True by using data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) directly (requires re-declaring the arg or reading raw request body), OR the simpler fix: split the payload into two schemas (InvoiceSettingsIn without template fields + a separate PUT for the templates screen) so each save only touches its own keys.

OPTIONAL client-side belt-and-braces: /app/frontend/app/settings/invoice.tsx save() should spread the current settings (…q.data) into the PUT payload so template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size ride along even before the backend is fixed.
OPTIONAL polish: the invoice-templates screen already spreads q.data; keep it consistent when refactoring.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:81-85 — put_invoice_settings does a blind $set of settings.invoice = data.model_dump(). Pydantic backfills every missing field with its default, so any partial save wipes the rest. This is exactly why the template/brand fields get reset from the Invoice settings screen. Merge with the existing document or use exclude_unset.

/app/frontend/app/settings/invoice.tsx:30-40 — save payload deliberately omits template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size. That is fine ONLY if the backend merges; today it does not. Safer to spread ...q.data first.

/app/frontend/app/settings/invoice-template.tsx:122-134 — save() correctly spreads q.data first, so this screen is not the culprit; but it still hard-codes the exact same list of scalar overrides. Consider a shared 'saveInvoiceSettings(patch)' helper that always fetches, merges and PUTs.

/app/frontend/src/invoice-templates.ts:47 — for the logo does not include ?token=; when the URL is /api/files/… the browser cannot fetch it without a token and the logo will be blank in the PDF paper. The upload path is fine, but the PDF preview will only show the logo when the URL is an absolute public URL. Consider proxying through a signed URL, or embedding the logo as a data-URL when building the invoice HTML.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — /app/backend/routes/invoicing.py put_invoice_settings (line 81-85) does {"$set": {"settings.invoice": data.model_dump()}}. Because InvoiceSettingsIn declares template='t3', brand_color='#014747', logo_url='', logo_size=90 as fields with defaults, any client that omits them (including the existing /settings/invoice screen) causes Pydantic to synthesise those defaults, which are then written straight over the persisted values. REPRODUCTION — with the owner logged in: (1) PUT /api/settings/invoice with template=t5,brand_color=#7A4BD0,logo_size=60 plus all other fields → 200; (2) PUT /api/settings/invoice with ONLY the payload the Invoice settings screen sends (no template/brand_color/logo_url/logo_size) → 200; (3) GET /api/settings/invoice → template=t3, brand_color=#014747, logo_size=90 (WIPED). MITIGATION — fetch-merge-then-set on the server (see action_items), and/or client-side spread of q.data before the PUT. Recommended fix is server-side because it protects every current and future client from the same class of bug.
